title: ogulcancelik/herdr
claim: ogulcancelik/herdr — agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
why_good: A terminal 'multiplexer' for running many agents at once — a real ergonomics need as devs juggle parallel agents, but a thin utility.
value: Team pro tier at best (shared sessions, orchestration); hard to charge for a terminal convenience.
risk: tmux-for-agents is easily replicated and gets folded into the agents/terminals themselves.

zh.claim: ogulcancelik/herdr —— 住在你终端里的 agent 多路复用器。
zh.why_good: 在终端里同时跑多个 agent 的"多路复用"——开发者并行使唤 agent 时的真实工效需求,但是个薄工具。
zh.value: 顶多做团队专业版(共享会话、编排);终端便利很难收费。
zh.risk: "agent 版 tmux"容易被复刻,会被 agent/终端本身吸收进去。
zh.hook: agent 版 tmux:在一个终端里跑并调度多个编码 agent。

hook: A tmux-for-agents: run and juggle many coding agents in a single terminal.
pick_reason: While it addresses a real need for developers, it appears to be a thin utility without a clear monetization strategy.
